mentions.name: bbbb (Python bytecode archive format)
mentions.description: A "bytecode archive" format for Python that speeds up imports for some projects, mainly by avoiding filesystem work at import time; planned to be offered as an install-time option in PAPER, with bbbb later making wheels that include precompiled bytecode.
mentions.problem: Python imports can be slow because of filesystem work at import time.
mentions.source_excerpt: work on others (in particular, a "bytecode archive" format for Python that speeds up imports for some projects, mainly by avoiding filesystem work at import time — I want to offer it as an install-time option in PAPER, and later have `bbbb` make wheels with the bytecode precompiled that way)
